comparison.objective: Carry a full cup safely past a laptop to a coaster; candidate screens a dry industrial mixture.
comparison.physical_skill: Stable liquid-container transport and obstacle clearance versus controlled feed pouring, bimanual sifting, and orientation-dependent particle passage.
comparison.success_condition: Cup upright on coaster with no spill, laptop contact, or unsafe proximity versus ≥98% media recovery with retained washers and no rim/floor loss.
comparison.reason: Although both penalize spilling, safe transport of one container is not granular separation.
